title: Zesty Slow Cooked Korean Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Korean-inspired stew featuring chicken, pecan nuts, and a blend of herbal spices, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish is Whole30-friendly and offers a unique cheese-pull experience.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine gochujang, coconut aminos, fish sauce, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
In a large slow cooker, combine the blended sauce, chicken thighs, and chopped pecan nuts.
Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 hours.
About 30 minutes before serving, stir in the chopped green onions.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional green onions and pecan nuts if desired.
To achieve the cheese-pull effect, serve with a side of cauliflower rice or zucchini noodles.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Garnish with toasted pecan nuts and a sprinkle of sesame seeds for added crunch and flavor.
